The '''Ailon First Honors Platoon''' was a military formation of the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]]. It carried the [[Regiment/Legends|regimental]] honors for the Nova Guard; each [[Honors Platoon Guardsman]] carried a banner during ceremonial occasions with up to thirty battle honors on it.
